BEFORE THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION

       THE UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE AND ALL OTHER
            FEDERAL EXECUTIVE AGENCIES’ NOTICE OF FILING
                          DIRECT TESTIMONY

       The United States Department of Defense and all other Federal Executive Agencies

(“DoD/FEA”) hereby files this Notice of Filing Direct Testimony in the above captioned matter.

DoD/FEA files the following:



       1. The Direct Testimony and Exhibits of Larry Blank
